_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent paper. D-band THz ISAC with full-photonic de-chirping using TFLN-MZM. High data rate (116 Gbps) and high resolution (6 mm).

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1: System architecture (FiWi, TFLN-MZM at AAU). Figure 2: Experimental setup (TDM LFM/QAM). Figure 6: Optical spectra showing de-chirped signal. Figure 8: Ranging resolution ~6mm. Figure 10: BER < 3.8e-3 for 29 Gbaud 16-QAM.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic-based THz ISAC for fiber-wireless. Innovation: Direct reception and de-chirping of LFM echo using TFLN-MZM at the remote unit (AAU), avoiding electrical mixers/EDs. Waveform: TDM of LFM (sensing) and 16-QAM (comm).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 116 Gbps (29 Gbaud * 4 bits/sym) peak rate. Sensing: 6 mm range resolution at 30 GHz BW. Error < 3 mm.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Simplifies AAU architecture by removing LO lasers and electrical mixers while maintaining high performance. Addresses fiber transmission impairments via photonic de-chirping.

bibliographic.title: THz Integrated Sensing and Communication With Full-Photonic Direct LFM Reception and De-Chirping for D-Band Fiber-Wireless Network
bibliographic.authors: Boyu Dong, Zhongya Li, Sizhe Xing, Yinjun Liu, Junhao Zhao, Ouhan Huang, Junlian Jia, Jianyang Shi, Yingjun Zhou, Haipeng Wang, Nan Chi, Junwen Zhan
bibliographic.venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques (TMTT)

application.scenario_description: Fiber-wireless network for 6G RAN, integrating sensing in the AAU (Active Antenna Unit).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Full-photonic direct reception and de-chirping of THz LFM echoes using broadband TFLN-MZM.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Existing photonic ISAC systems rely on electrical mixers/EDs for down-conversion, limiting bandwidth and complexity.

transmitter.notes: Optical heterodyning of two ECLs to generate 134 GHz carrier. 30 GHz LFM bandwidth.

receiver.notes: Photonic de-chirping at AAU using TFLN-MZM. Baseband processing at CU/DU.

integration.notes: TDM of LFM and QAM. Shared THz antenna and photonic frontend.

channel_wireless.notes: 149 GHz LO for downconversion at UE.

comm_metrics.notes: 116 Gbps peak rate (29 Gbaud, 16QAM). BER below HD-FEC limit.

sensing_metrics.notes: 6 mm resolution. 3 mm accuracy after calibration.
